g.text: 1. ALARM
fight-flight! adrenalin,
pulse up, fear!
2. RESISTANCE
coping holds, body
pays quietly!
3A. RECOVERY
threat ends, rest,
growth!
3B. EXHAUSTION — illness, collapse, burnout!
stress unrelieved → ulcers, HTN, depression, errors
nurse AND patient — intervene at 2, never 3B!
GAS (Selye — exam!): ALARM (fight-flight: adrenalin, cortisol, pulse/BP/sugar UP)
→ RESISTANCE (coping holds, resources drain) → RECOVERY or EXHAUSTION (systems fail:
ulcers, HTN, infections, depression, burnout!). Nurse acts at RESISTANCE — rest, relief,
referral — before exhaustion bills arrive.
LAZARUS (appraisal!): stress = event × MEANING. Primary ("threat? challenge? loss?") +
secondary ("can I cope? help available?") → coping → re-appraisal. Same diagnosis: threat
("I'll die!") vs challenge ("I'll fight!") — nurse REFRAMES appraisals (M05!).
FIGHT-FLIGHT-FREEZE: pupils, pulse, breath, sugar, digestion OFF, immunity DOWN. Chronic
= disease: HTN, diabetes, ulcers, infertility, infections, poor healing, mental illness.
Calming the body (breathing! presence! pain relief!) IS treating disease.
STRESSORS RANKED (Holmes-Rahe!): death of spouse/child, divorce, illness, job loss, moves,
exams, money — STACKED stressors multiply: bereaved + broke + ill = crisis watch (M03.2!).
NURSE'S OWN STRESS: shifts, deaths, hierarchy, exams — recognise YOUR phase (snapping?
numb? dreading shifts? = resistance fraying!) → sleep + food + debrief + boundaries + help
(COM M02!). Burnout nurses harm patients — self-care IS safety (PRO-II!).
WARD CALMERS: explain before doing · choices · pain treated FIRST · families near · noise
down · sleep guarded · prayer room · honest timelines. Calm wards heal; chaos wards sicken.
LINKS: COM presence · NUT comfort · GER rest · PRO-II wellbeing.
MANTRA: "alarm informs, resistance warns, exhaustion bills — act at two."
